reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: As for PLAYER_A, he has been pitching brilliantly this season and is truly the backbone of the team. If he continues to perform at this level, he will surely earn a major award.

reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: As for PLAYER_A, he has posted stats this season that truly live up to his reputation as the team’s top slugger. If he keeps this up, winning a title is not just a dream.

reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: As for PLAYER_A, he’s been hitting well this season, and the batting title is not out of the question. To clinch the title, he’ll need to go on a hot streak around now.

reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: As for PLAYER_A, he’s been on a roll this season and looks poised to sweep all the major pitching titles. I hope he goes down in baseball history.

reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: As for PLAYER_A, perhaps because he’s been pushing too hard from the start, he lacks stamina in the middle and late innings. I plan to have him focus on pitching in a way that conserves his stamina.

reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: It seems that PLAYER_A is listening intently to PLAYER_B’s training methods in an effort to learn from his seemingly inexhaustible stamina. I’m looking forward to seeing what results this brings.

reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: There are often games in the pennant race that you simply cannot afford to lose, and today’s matchup against the Tigers is exactly that kind of game. reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: PLAYER_B is known for his powerful arm, but it seems he’s been giving advice to PLAYER_A lately. I hope PLAYER_A will be able to absorb these excellent techniques.

reviewed_cases.source: 過酷なペナントレースを戦って行く上で、選手たちの体調は気になるところだ。@n最近練習を見ていて、その動きが気になるのが@v@t@vだ。@n体のキレが落ちてきている印象があるのだ。@fまだ過酷な闘いはこれからも続く。@n@v@t@vをここでパンクさせてしまう訳にはいかないのだ。@n@v休養をさせるべき@vか否か。
reviewed_cases.english: Keeping players healthy matters in a long pennant race.@nI've been watching @v@t@v in practice.@nOur player looks a step slower lately.@fThere are more tough games ahead.@nWe can't afford to lose @v@t@v now.@nShould we @vgive that player some rest@v?
reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: As we battle through this grueling pennant race, the players’ physical condition is a major concern. Watching practice recently, PLAYER_A’s movements have caught my attention. I get the impression that his agility is starting to decline. The grueling battle is far from over. We can’t afford to let PLAYER_A burn out at this point. Should we give him a rest or not?

reviewed_cases.source: 野手コーチの提案で走塁の新しいトレーニングを導入することにした。@nこの走塁練習はどちらかというと走塁の意識改革をさせるようなものらしく、知らず知らずに走塁の基礎が身につく効果があるらしい。@fさすがはうちのコーチといったところだが、果たして選手たちへ@vどのような影響を及ぼすのだろうか？@v
reviewed_cases.english: The fielding coach proposed a new baserunning drill.@nThe idea is to change how players think on the bases so that the fundamentals become second nature.@fIt's a thoughtful plan. Now let's see @vhow the team responds.@v
reviewed_cases.deepl_meaning_example: Based on a suggestion from the fielding coach, we’ve decided to introduce a new baserunning drill. This drill seems to be more about changing the players’ mindset toward baserunning, and it’s said to help them unconsciously master the fundamentals. It’s exactly the kind of idea you’d expect from our coach, but I wonder what kind of impact it will have on the players?

meaning_decisions: Keep the distinct learner (@t), other player (@u), opponent team (@e) and milestone count (@x) roles.
Recovering does not assume that an unspecified absence is an injury.
The starter should set up the bullpen well; the source does not require handing over a lead.
The playing-time complaint is not fully resolved, rather than necessarily making no progress.
The pacing problem applies from the middle innings onward, with a tentative cause.
Career milestones use a neutral subject rather than adding an explicit manager/player viewpoint.
Fielding Coach is retained because it matches the relevant 2026 role label.
